# velin-hover

Hover lift/glow animation.

## Values
| Value | Meaning | Bridges to |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (empty / present) | Hover lift / glow | Motion CSS |
## Example

```html
<div velin-hover>…</div>
```

## Accessibility
